text: Election of the Chair of the Nominating Panel - Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A2, for a term of office until a successor is appointed

The Nominating Panel - Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner: Elected Voy Stelmaszynski as Chair of the Nominating Panel - Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner for a term of office until a successor is appointed.
